subject: Re: Trafficly weekend load test — credit top-up confirmation
messages:
From: Trafficly Ops <ops@trafficly.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: weekend credit bump for POC load test

Hi Ben,

We’re ramping up a short, intensive throughput/latency run this coming weekend to validate real-time traffic routing for our recommender. Given the expected spike (peak qps ~5k, sustained 30m windows), our sandbox credits will exhaust quickly. Can Redwood provision a short-term credit top-up and extend our trial window by 72 hours so we can finish the soak?

Quick details:
- Test window: Sat 2025-06-07 02:00–08:00 UTC (late-night window for us)
- Workload: 100ms target p95 latency, 512 token average response
- Requested: 50k token credits + 72hr trial extension
- Contacts: ops@trafficly.com (me), procure@trafficly.com (billing)

We’ve attached our mutual action plan (MAP) and a short load plan CSV. Let us know if you need any additional security or test isolation notes.

Thanks — looking to confirm by EOD today.

— Sam Mallory
Trafficly Ops
ops@trafficly.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Trafficly Ops <ops@trafficly.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: weekend credit bump for POC load test

Sam — thanks for the clear rundown and the MAP. I copied Neha (SE) to confirm the workload profile and expected token burn. A couple quick Qs before I escalate for a short-term top-up:

- Is the 512 token average request per call an estimate including system prompts?
- Will you run any long-context transcripts that would increase KV cache pressure?
- Do you need isolated routing (dedicated sandbox) or is our shared dev cluster fine?

If Neha signs off, I can approve a one-time 50k token grant and a 72-hour extension from the start of your test window. I’ll also loop Jordan for a quick sign-off on promo credits.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Trafficly Ops <ops@trafficly.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: weekend credit bump for POC load test

Thanks Sam — quick technical notes from our side:

- 512 tokens/request including system + user is fine; if you can drop system prompt length by ~20 tokens we’ll save notable burn.
- No long-range KV cache expected per your MAP; throughput pattern (bursts of 5k qps for 30s every 5 mins) is a good stress shape.
- Shared dev cluster is acceptable for this test but we recommend enabling prefix caching on the client to reduce cost during repeated prompt shapes.

I’ve reviewed the CSV loadplan. We don’t expect data residency or isolation blockers. From a risk perspective this is low — I support the requested 50k credits + 72hr extension.

Attached: short checklist for weekend ops (Trafficly_MAP_v1.pdf).

Neha Kapoor
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Trafficly Ops <ops@trafficly.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: one-off promo credits (Trafficly TL-2025-042)

Jordan — can you greenlight a one-time promotional credit grant of 50k tokens and a 72-hour trial extension for Trafficly (deal TL-2025-042)?

Summary: low-risk POC weekend soak to validate latency at scale. SE confirms no isolation needed and recommends caching tweaks. External attached MAP and load plan. If approved, I’ll apply the credit and confirm the timeframe.

Requested: 50,000 tokens; extension window begins 2025-06-07T02:00:00Z and runs +72 hours.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Trafficly Ops <ops@trafficly.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: one-off promo credits (Trafficly TL-2025-042)

Approved.

Ben — apply 50,000 trial tokens to Trafficly account TL-2025-042 and extend trial by 72 hours starting 2025-06-07T02:00:00Z. Mark as promotional one-off in the contract notes and flag in HubSpot so finance knows this is non-recurring. Neha — please send the ops checklist to Sam and include the recommended prefix-caching snippet.

Sam — you’re all set from our side. Please reply here when the run completes with links to the latency/throughput dashboard so we can capture results for the catalog.

Jordan Blake
Manager, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
